idempotency_key.title: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key. Use this field when a payment order write action will continue asynchronously to match the `payment_order` on your side

min_payment_amount.title: Minimal payment amount
min_payment_amount.description: Payee-defined minimum payment amount for dynamic amount recurrences.

dynamic_amount.title: Dynamic amount
dynamic_amount.description: Defines if this recurrence payment can be defined the min and max amounts

allow_attempts_after_expiration.title: Allow Attempts After the Expiration
allow_attempts_after_expiration.description: Defines if the payment order can be retried after the expiration date

expiration_date.title: Expiration Date
expiration_date.description: Maximum date for the Payer accept the authorization

first_payment_date.title: First payment date
first_payment_date.description: The first date of the payment to be payed by the Payer

last_payment_date.title: Last payment date
last_payment_date.description: The final date (end of the contract) of the payment to be payed by the Payer

document_type.title: Document type
document_type.description:
Document type:
- `LEGAL_PERSON` - An actual person with legal rights.
- `NATURAL_PERSON` - An entity, such as an organization or company.

document_number.title: Document number
document_number.description: A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil). Must be numeric with 11-14 digits.
